summary: Upgrade the chart on the CLI with helm repo update, helm search repo openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal and helm upgrade <release> openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal --version <chart_version>, or in the console via Helm > release > Actions > Upgrade choosing the Chart Version and checking custom values; then confirm pods are Running in Topology.
questions: helm upgrade command for self-service automation portal
How do I find the latest portal chart version?
Upgrade the portal chart from the OpenShift console

answer_card.title: Upgrade the portal Helm chart
answer_card.answer_md:
**CLI**
```bash
helm repo update
helm search repo openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal
helm upgrade <release_name> openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal --version <chart_version>
```
**Console**: Developer > **Helm** > release > **Actions > Upgrade** > pick *Chart Version*, check the YAML keeps your custom values > **Upgrade**.

Then check Topology: all portal pods *Running*.
